releaseNotes.zh-CN:
- 完善 Android 13–17 系统定位兼容性，提升 Google 定位服务与常见定位调用的稳定性。
- 优化配置快照发送与生效反馈，减少等待时间和持续显示生效中的问题。
- 提升虚拟视频和音频录制的流畅度、方向兼容性与声音质量。
- 新增本地照片输入，可替换相机预览、录像画面和拍照；照片模式保留真实麦克风，已启用应用优先显示。
releaseNotes.en:
- Improved Android 13–17 system location compatibility and reliability with Google location services and common location requests.
- Improved configuration delivery and status feedback to reduce delays and profiles remaining in an applying state.
- Improved virtual video and audio recording smoothness, orientation compatibility, and sound quality.
- Added local image input for camera previews, recordings, and photos; image mode keeps the real microphone, and enabled apps are shown first.
